product_name: bitbank 暗号資産を貸して増やす
custody_model: The reviewed first-party materials describe a lending arrangement in which users lend crypto assets to bitbank and receive a contractual usage/lending fee. First-party ETHW fork guidance distinguishes assets lent through this service from the segregated-management balance used for ordinary exchange custody in that context. CYA therefore records borrower/counterparty exposure during the lending contract and does not infer segregated custody, insurance, or guaranteed principal for lent balances.
yield_source: The reviewed public materials establish contractual usage/lending fees but do not establish an independently verified economic source for every fee payment. Published rates remain issuer product terms rather than verified realized returns.
risk_notes: Current first-party support documents a standard one-year maturity and return of the lent crypto plus the prescribed usage/lending fee after maturity. Early termination is available through support subject to an early-termination fee. Current mechanics do not prove universal historical repayment performance.
